  "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78897726/inputs/dataset_00ff814b-aa27-4fcc-a1a0-cc55c07be8bb.dat" <<'PY'
import re
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"

def shared_strings(z):
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
    except KeyError:
        return []
    return ["".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(NS + "t")) for si in root.findall(NS + "si")]

def cell_value(cell, ss):
    kind = cell.attrib.get("t")
    if kind == "inlineStr":
        return "".join(t.text or "" for t in cell.iter(NS + "t"))
    v = cell.find(NS + "v")
    if v is None:
        return ""
    raw = v.text or ""
    if kind == "s":
        return ss[int(raw)]
    if kind == "b":
        return "TRUE" if raw == "1" else "FALSE"
    return raw

def sheet_rows(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        ss = shared_strings(z)
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
        rows = []
        for row in root.findall(".//" + NS + "row"):
            rn = int(row.attrib.get("r", "0"))
            vals = {}
            for cell in row.findall(NS + "c"):
                ref = cell.attrib.get("r", "")
                col = "".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
                if col:
                    vals[col] = cell_value(cell, ss)
            rows.append((rn, vals))
        return sorted(rows, key=lambda x: x[0])

def norm_id(value):
    s = str(value or "").strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", s):
        s = s.split(".", 1)[0]
    return s

def first_nonempty(row):
    for col in sorted(row, key=lambda x: (len(x), x)):
        if str(row[col]).strip():
            return str(row[col]).strip()
    return ""

def header_map(row):
    return {str(value).strip(): col for col, value in row.items() if str(value).strip()}

def parse_float(value):
    s = str(value or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    if s.endswith("%"):
        return float(s[:-1]) / 100.0
    return float(s)

def gene_tokens(value):
    return {x.upper() for x in re.split(r"[;,|/\s]+", str(value or "")) if x}

def sort_id(value):
    s = str(value)
    return (0, int(s)) if s.isdigit() else (1, s)

genes_rows = sheet_rows(sys.argv[1])
chip_genes = {first_nonempty(row).upper() for _, row in genes_rows if first_nonempty(row)}
if not chip_genes:
    raise RuntimeError("Supplied CHIP gene list is empty")

trio_rows = sheet_rows(sys.argv[2])
trio_header = next((row for rn, row in trio_rows if rn == 1), None)
if trio_header is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Trio-status header row not found")
th = header_map(trio_header)
for required in ("Sample ID", "Status", "BLM Mutation Status"):
    if required not in th:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing trio-status column: " + required)

carrier_info = {}
for rn, row in trio_rows:
    if rn == 1:
        continue
    sid = norm_id(row.get(th["Sample ID"], ""))
    if not sid:
        continue
    blm = str(row.get(th["BLM Mutation Status"], "")).strip()
    role = str(row.get(th["Status"], "")).strip()
    if blm.lower() == "carrier":
        carrier_info[sid] = (blm, role)

if not carrier_info:
    raise RuntimeError("No BLM carrier rows found in trio-status table")

def variant_sample(rows, path):
    for rn, row in rows:
        if rn != 1:
            continue
        for value in row.values():
            m = re.search(r"\(([^()]*)\)", str(value))
            if m:
                token = m.group(1).strip()
                sid = token if token.upper().startswith("SRR") else token.split("-", 1)[0]
                return sid, token
    name = Path(path).name
    m = re.search(r"_CHIP_([^.]*)", name)
    token = m.group(1) if m else name
    sid = token if token.upper().startswith("SRR") else token.split("-", 1)[0]
    return sid, token

def count_variants(path):
    rows = sheet_rows(path)
    sid, token = variant_sample(rows, path)
    header_row = next((row for rn, row in rows if rn == 2), None)
    if header_row is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Variant header row not found for " + token)
    vh = header_map(header_row)
    needed = ("Zygosity", "Variant Allele Freq", "Gene Names",
              "Sequence Ontology (Combined)", "In_CHIP")
    for required in needed:
        if required not in vh:
            raise RuntimeError("Missing variant column " + required + " in " + token)
    count = 0
    for rn, row in rows:
        if rn <= 2:
            continue
        if str(row.get(vh["Zygosity"], "")).strip().lower() == "reference":
            continue
        try:
            vaf = parse_float(row.get(vh["Variant Allele Freq"], ""))
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if vaf is None or not vaf < 0.3:
            continue
        ontology = str(row.get(vh["Sequence Ontology (Combined)"], "")).strip().lower()
        if any(term in ontology for term in ("intron", "intergenic", "utr")):
            continue
        if str(row.get(vh["In_CHIP"], "")).strip().lower() not in {"true", "1", "yes"}:
            continue
        if not (gene_tokens(row.get(vh["Gene Names"], "")) & chip_genes):
            continue
        count += 1
    return sid, token, count

records = []
seen = set()
for path in sys.argv[3:]:
    sid, token, count = count_variants(path)
    if sid not in carrier_info:
        continue
    if sid in seen:
        raise RuntimeError("Duplicate variant file for carrier sample " + sid)
    seen.add(sid)
    blm, role = carrier_info[sid]
    records.append((sid, blm, role, token, count))

records.sort(key=lambda x: sort_id(x[0]))
missing = sorted(set(carrier_info) - seen, key=sort_id)
if not records:
    raise RuntimeError("No carrier variant files were available")
median_value = median([x[4] for x in records])

def fmt_number(value):
    f = float(value)
    return str(int(f)) if f.is_integer() else format(f, ".15g")

with open("analysis.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("#scope\tBLM Mutation Status == Carrier; available supplied variant files\n")
    out.write("#chip_definition\tIn_CHIP == True and Gene Names intersects supplied CHIP gene list\n")
    out.write("#vaf_definition\tVariant Allele Freq < 0.3\n")
    out.write("#excluded\tSequence Ontology containing intron, intergenic, or UTR; Zygosity == Reference\n")
    out.write("#carrier_rows_in_trio_status\t" + str(len(carrier_info)) + "\n")
    out.write("#carrier_variant_files_analyzed\t" + str(len(records)) + "\n")
    out.write("#missing_carrier_sample_ids\t" + (",".join(missing) if missing else "None") + "\n")
    out.write("sample_id\tBLM_Mutation_Status\tStatus\tvariant_file_sample\tsomatic_chip_variant_count\n")
    for sid, blm, role, token, count in records:
        out.write("\t".join((sid, blm, role, token, str(count))) + "\n")
    out.write("median_somatic_chip_variants\t\t\t\t" + fmt_number(median_value) + "\n")
PY
